overall_assessment:
Assessment and scope
No new unresolved blocking architecture-adherence finding is established by the embedded r41 package. The changed reducer addresses SEC-R35-01/ADH-R35-01 within the approved owner and preserves the frozen architecture. The session-test diagnostics and normal-create counter correction do not weaken the protection harness. Candidate adherence may proceed to disposition; delivery remains Pending. This review used only the supplied package, without tools, execution, file edits or independent hash verification.

Decision evidence table
| Decision | Position | Evidence and limits |
| D01 | Adherent at candidate scope | Authenticated seller journeys preserve direct submission without administrator approval. The controller retains ATENDENTE admission, and draft services distinguish ownership from ADMIN/OWNER authority. The changed session test additionally proves current administrator authority is required after provider I/O. |
| D02 | Adherent | Backend normalization, preview and durable fingerprints remain authoritative. Modelos retains escaped text rendering, 300ms debounce, persisted-preview submission requirements and context/editor/edit guards. No parser, preview DTO or provider contract changes occur in this delta. |
| D03 | Adherent | Draft/revision/submission ownership remains in message-templates. Save CAS, immutable submitted snapshots and explicit new-draft variations remain unchanged. The consumer metadata tracks the operation selected by each accepted draft commit; it creates no alternative persistence or deduplication owner. |
| D04 | Adherent | Scoped account/resource/generation/credential binding remains unchanged. The resolver binds an operation-specific provider and keeps credentials private. Existing changed-account block/copy and same-account reauthorization evidence is carried. Historical authorized reads remain distinct from current mutation authority. |
| D05 | Adherent on unchanged producer evidence | Session/CSRF endpoints, revision/fingerprint confirmation, durable reservation/quota and captured dispatch checks remain. The approved bounded name-filtered provider preflight is preserved; it is not replaced with unrestricted catalogue traversal. The consumer correction adds no HTTP or backend contract. |
| D06 | Adherent on carried producer assurance | ACCEPTED remains separate from approval. Typed refusal/ambiguity, one-POST policy, immutable association, independent ACK evidence and local persistence certainty remain unchanged. Omitted unchanged submission methods are supported by the supplied freeze and prior resolutions, rather than independently reinspected here. |
| D07 | Adherent for the affected correction | Page adoption compares current same-resource observations, retains the currently selected resource when omitted, and preserves returned membership/cursor. Common eligibility and strict draft proof remain separate. Status, historical classification, failure restrictions, observedAt and TTL remain protected. OPS-R4-01 retains its accepted bounded disposition. |
| D08 | Adherent for the affected correction | Selection ownership now resides in current reducer metadata instead of request-start catalogue arguments. Clear/Novo transitions erase it. The pure regressions and both real-BFF browser sequences cover abandoned A and selected B with newer PAUSED evidence. Existing dirty-edit, recovery, passive/derived-read and context guards remain. |
| D09 | Adherent | The narrow template provider exposes create/list/get only. TemplateManagementModule imports ChannelTransportModule and aliases the abstract token to the existing scoped resolver. Explicit official-provider registration remains in integration code. No textual Channel extension, fake unsupported implementation, concrete-provider branch in consumers or generic framework is introduced. |
| CR-01 | Adherent on carried evidence | Draft/operation GETs remain observational. Recovery remains explicit on the same persisted operation, with lease/CAS transitions and GET-only external reconciliation. No automatic mutation replay is added. |
| CR-02 | Adherent on unchanged producer evidence | Conservative typed refusal versus ambiguity semantics remain intact. UI notices distinguish correlation, acknowledged creation and ACK conflict. No error-text inference or new success fallback appears. |
| AR-V11-01 | Adherent on carried evidence | Claim/receipt/release certainty and bounded exact readback remain the approved model. Real PostgreSQL fault coverage is carried through the unchanged suite. Consumer changes do not reinterpret uncertain persistence or authorize another POST. |
| AR-V11-02 | Adherent on carried evidence | Global technical account/name/quota coordination remains separate from scoped business data. Existing same-account cross-BU/cross-tenant contention and different-account tests are carried; the 100 distinct-account success marker is not substituted for those contention tests. |
| AR-V11-03 | Adherent by supplied attestations | Initial admission records three HEADs and all 41 inherited comparisons. Current receipts report 38 frozen sources, 30 protected seals, the approved BCI companion and unchanged product HEADs. These assertions were not independently recomputed here. |
| CR-V11-01 | Adherent for the affected consumer path; backend protections preserved | Both producers retain one persistent context lease/fence/projector, transactional authorization/context checks and bounded HTTP outside transactions. The correction protects newer observations already admitted by the consumer while leaving server write authority unchanged. |

Current-selection ownership and structural soundness
The reducer retains the two existing observation slices and adds nullable identity metadata. selected-operation records identity even when no saved observation exists, and removes an individual observation belonging to another resource. clear-individual clears both identity and individual observation; clear-all clears the complete context. Product catalogue actions no longer declare or consume a request-time selected ID. The deliberately extra stale-A fields in named pure fixtures exercise rejection of obsolete input and are not a shipped fallback.

All 12 draft-state commit sites were considered: trocarBu and trocarCanal clear the complete observation context; createVariationFromDefinition and novoRascunho clear individual ownership; abrirRascunho establishes the guarded opened operation; both salvar branches and retomarCriacaoPendente establish the returned operation; enviar success establishes its returned operation; enviar recovery catch and recuperar establish the operation from authoritative draft readback; consultarOperacao updates selection for the matching draft revision. Existing context/editor/request guards remain around asynchronous adoption. restoreSavedObservation now requires a nonempty expected resource identity and exact candidate equality, in addition to observation authority.

Catalogue completion reads current.selectedRemoteTemplateId. Before replacing page membership, it selects the highest relevant current page/individual observation for that resource and retains it in the existing individual slice if omitted. This handles B even when its observation exists only in a page. It does not reinsert omitted IDs into page membership or derive cursors from retained observations. After Novo, cleared ownership cannot restore A. After A-to-B selection, an old A request cannot displace B's newer PAUSED observation with B's older APPROVED snapshot. The new pure tests assert these transitions and exact cursors; the two browser sequences exercise actual BFF responses and final DOM state.

Existing protections remain substantive: common eligibility is not reconstructed from APPROVED or combined with boolean OR; editor eligibility requires positive matchesDefinition and eligibleForUse; genuine common unavailability remains restrictive; historical context classification survives failure; current context can supersede historical higher numeric fences; malformed fences cannot establish eligibility; 202 does not complete meaningful observation authority; passive reads do not advance it; derived reads retain their originating intent. Dirty text, operation provenance, ACK restrictions and the 300-second expiry remain unchanged.

Harness integrity
The two-line normal-create counter repair changes the queried collection to meta.templateCalls and uses the existing templateCallCount helper, retaining expected count 2. Normal successful creation does not populate the fixture's conditional effects collection. Existing 201/ACCEPTED/resource checks and every preceding PAUSED/ineligible/omission assertion remain. This corrects measurement ownership without asserting external exactly-once behavior.

The complete changed session test and surrounding harness retain real login, signed session, CSRF, BFF and PostgreSQL behavior. Each of seven scenarios must actually enter the held provider boundary before invalidation. The tagged race observes that entry, the same real HTTP promise, or a native 10-second diagnostic deadline; early HTTP completion, rejection and deadline exhaustion fail. The timer is cleared, and no outcome fabricates provider entry or cancels a request. Fixed diagnostic labels and numeric statuses avoid credential/body logging. Password and expiry checks use the session service's millisecond claims. Date.now remains expired through real HTTP settlement; cleanup releases the held gate, genuinely drains requests, and restores clock/fetch through nested finally blocks. All six 401 assertions, the administrator downgrade 403, observation snapshot equality and the overall 60-second timeout remain.

The protection harness therefore remains aligned with the approved intent. Dependency/port tests and unchanged PostgreSQL concurrency/fault cases are carried through current canonical execution. No new test-only product endpoint, authorization bypass, silent real-to-mock fallback, DI token/scope substitution or production test switch is evidenced by this delta.

Performance and elegance
Performance is acceptable. Current-selection retention uses temporary scans/indexes over explicitly loaded observations, adds constant-sized metadata and introduces no provider request, fan-out, background reconciliation or persistent third cache. Supplied SQL and plans preserve parent pagination before child hydration, operation probes bounded by returned rows, detail history capped at 11 operations with 10 receipts each, and catalogue hydration through at most 50 indexed resource probes. Deep OFFSET, exact counts and bounded sequential writes retain their disclosed costs; no new severe runtime risk is demonstrated. The five-tenant mixed stage and synthetic measurements do not establish production capacity, latency SLOs or saturation behavior.

Elegance is acceptable. Selection identity belongs beside the atomic retention transition that consumes it. This is a small, faithful extension of the existing reducer, with no additional ref mirror, state framework, generic capability platform or compatibility bridge. Domain rules, provider protocol, secrets and consumer projection retain their established responsibilities. The nullable argument repairs preserve selector contracts rather than bypassing typing. No architectural redesign or cosmetic refactor is required for this review.

Executed evidence and uncertainty
The supplied canonical command is bash scripts/test-channels-local.sh all. Current r41 reports exit 0 with 284 API unit, 398 PostgreSQL, 45 Web unit and 75 Playwright cases, totaling 802; Playwright includes 74 browser cases and one pure consumer case. Source/runtime attestations report matching served/dist bytes, Node 22.23.3, disposable PostgreSQL and 25 completed migrations. All five template marker families are present. Both template FRC markers originate in the browser main workflow: one proves 100 real BFF calls with 99 safe 202 responses and one completed leader; the other separately proves 100 UI attempts coalesced into one BFF refresh, ending PAUSED/ineligible. Session diagnostics report seven actual provider entries, six 401 responses, one 403, eight completed snapshots and genuine cleanup.

Historical evidence remains bounded: r36 is pure Web causal RED with build success and three reached failures; its later page-only branch and browser tests were not reached before correction. r37 is a compile failure. r38 reached the new behavioral assertions and failed the final fixture counter. r39 remains an unattributed opaque timeout; r40 and r41 do not prove its cause or establish that it was fixed or flaky. Earlier partial-capture and first-assertion limits remain carried, and later regressions do not retroactively establish feature-level test-first execution. The new tests establish their specific empty-200 catalogue omission behavior; broader empty-success coverage and a browser ACK-conflict race remain unestablished.

Operational fit and retained debt
Operational fit remains mixed because of accepted limitations and outstanding activation/provider gates, not a newly established blocking drift. OPS-R4-01 remains accepted conservative availability debt under foundation_documentation/backlog/README.md#BLG-leadshug-template-failure-observation-authority, owned by the Web/integrations observation maintainer. A delayed code-only failure can withdraw local availability while preserving newer status/time/fence/resource/content; explicit successful refresh recovers. This does not relax mandatory backend CAS or permit stale APPROVED promotion. SEC-R6-04 remains private-local-cohort-only debt under foundation_documentation/backlog/README.md#BLG-leadshug-template-recovery-read-budget, owned by integrations/security, before untrusted public admission or Railway. TQA-ST05-03 retains the original test-after/unknown process classification. Reported operator-confirmed credential containment is accepted with no retest, renewed confirmation, historical-nonuse or text-retraction claim.

No temporary architecture exception or approval-breaking divergence is established. Formal current PCV disposition, preserved TEST metadata preflight, two additive migrations, source-bound API/Web activation, owned HTTPS/normal access, one assisted actual Meta draft submission/status proof, canonical module consolidation and fresh final review remain mandatory. Hosted CI, actual Meta compatibility/approval, recipient sending, preserved runtime activation and production readiness are not established by this candidate package.
recommended_path: Accept the affected r41 architecture-adherence correction with no new blocking finding, and record this assessment alongside the existing accepted debts. Complete the remaining independent candidate reviews and formal PCV disposition before the approved bounded preserved-TEST preflight/migrations and source-bound local activation. Obtain the assisted actual Meta submit-once/status evidence, consolidate the canonical module contracts, and perform fresh final review against that actual proof. Keep delivery Pending until those gates are satisfied; no redesign, additional broad rerun, recipient send or promotion follows from this review.
